# Hosted checks

`ci.yml` owns the existing Node 22/24 full check, example and disposable Influx
service, plus the Node 22.13 minimum-runtime SQLite check. Preserve those gates.
The shared file-size job is pinned to a reviewed checker commit. Its empty
baseline permits no oversized-source exception or exclusion. Both runtime jobs
finish independently so a failure on one Node profile does not cancel the other.

The current source manifest and lock were generated by the temporary branch-only
producer at commit `5451704b`, run `42142124615`, with npm 11.19 and Node 24.21.
Only the two intended native dependency ranges changed; the producer used strict
public-registry resolution, distinct empty npm configs and disabled lifecycle
scripts. Its retained output files were adopted verbatim, then the temporary
workflow was removed. A declared singleton is not an installed singleton.

The final candidate must pass ordinary locked installation and all current
acceptance gates. These workflows perform no package publication, source push
or release dispatch. The publisher and release version remain separate review
decisions.

Each Node 22/24 job additionally runs the adjacent inert inspector controls and
the real packed current-cohort consumer, retaining bounded evidence even after
failure. This preserves the full original suite and disposable Influx service;
the packed consumer itself uses only finite local data and the pure encoder.
